name: Umbral Draw
description:
Draws the Spear, the Bole, the Ewer\ from your divining deck.
Additional Effect: Restores 20% of maximum MP
Upon execution, Play I changes to The Spear, Play II changes to The Bole, Play III changes to The Ewer\, and Umbral Draw changes to Astral Draw.
Shares a recast timer with Astral Draw.

※This action cannot be assigned to a hotbar.
※Astral Draw changes to Umbral Draw when requirements for execution are met.
